name: NFTX
description: NFTX is a platform for making ERC20 tokens that are backed by NFT collectibles.

methodology.Fees: Vault fees paid in ETH to mint, redeem or swap NFTs, premium fees paid to redeem recently deposited NFTs, and swap fees on the NFTX AMM's vToken/WETH pools. Excludes early-withdrawal penalties, which are paid in vTokens, and the optional creator royalties paid through the NFTX marketplace zap.
methodology.Revenue: Vault fees that go to the NFTX treasury because the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Vault fees that go to the NFTX treasury.
methodology.Volume: WETH side of swaps on the NFTX AMM's vToken/WETH pools, which include NFT buys and sells routed through NFTX. Pools on the AMM that pair WETH with tokens other than NFTX vTokens are excluded. Trading of NFTX V2 vTokens on Sushiswap pools is excluded and attributed to Sushiswap.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of vault fees to the vToken's 0.3% pool LPs and 20% to inventory stakers, 90% of premium fees to the NFT's depositor, and all AMM swap fees to LPs.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: NFTX V3 pays nothing to token holders.

Fees.Vault Fees: Fees paid in ETH to mint, redeem or swap NFTs in an NFTX vault, plus 10% of premium fees.
Fees.NFT Premium Fees: The 90% of premium fees passed to the NFT's depositor. A premium starts at 5x one vToken and decays to zero over the 10 hours after an NFT is deposited.
Fees.AMM Swap Fees: Swap fees on the NFTX AMM's vToken/WETH pools (0.3% or 1% fee tiers).

Revenue.Vault Fees To Treasury: Vault fees sent to the NFTX treasury when the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.

ProtocolRevenue.Vault Fees To Treasury: Vault fees sent to the NFTX treasury when the vault had no LPs or inventory stakers to receive them.

SupplySideRevenue.Vault Fees To Liquidity Providers: 80% of vault fees, paid to LPs of the vToken's 0.3% pool.
SupplySideRevenue.Vault Fees To Inventory Stakers: 20% of vault fees, paid to inventory stakers.
SupplySideRevenue.NFT Premium Fees To Depositors: 90% of premium fees, paid to the address that deposited the redeemed NFT.
SupplySideRevenue.AMM Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: All NFTX AMM swap fees, paid to the pool's LPs (the AMM protocol fee is off).
